newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bic, Usinor up on CAC entry hopes.
newsitem.headline: Bic, Usinor up on CAC entry hopes.

text.p: Shares in steelmaker Usinor Sacilor and pen and lighter company Bic rose in a weak market on Wednesday on expectations one of them may replace insurer UAP in the CAC-40 index, brokers said.
UAP will vacate a slot if its merger with insurer Axa goes through.

Brokers said the companies' fundamentals also justified the gains of 3.59 percent in Usinor shares and 0.49 percent in Bic shares to a historic high of 816 francs at 1345 GMT. The CAC index was down 1.7 percent.
Usinor looks attractive to investors targeting those shares that have underperformed the market, which is nearing an all time record set in 1994, they said.
Brokerage Oddo recommended to clients they buy the share, and Dynabourse and Paribas Capital Markets recently published favourable reports on the company.
Brokers said Bic was also benefiting from the dollar's rise and liquidity in its shares.
Investors are watching three other blue chips that may vacate the CAC for a variety of reasons -- food group Saint-Louis, Eurotunnel and Thomson CSF.
